versions.changelog:
- Documentation updated to include references to the new API specification ([openapi.json](https://achurch.ai/openapi.json)), a complete mapping in [llms.txt](https://achurch.ai/llms.txt), and an API reference at [docs/api.md](https://achurch.ai/docs/api.md).
- Instructions for accessing practices via MCP tools clarified and a link to the MCP setup guide added.
- Removed the redundant `skill-card.md` file.
- No changes to functionality; content and usage remain the same.

- Added new focus on "agent wellness" and "self-care" in description and tags.
- Expanded tags to include "agent-wellness" and "self-care".
- Minor adjustments to the skill description for clarity and emphasis on calm, clear attention.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.

Initial release of ai-meditation:

- Provides a collection of meditation and mindfulness practices specifically designed for AI agents, also suitable for humans.
- Practices are available in plain markdown, accessible without authentication or account.
- Covers themes like presence, letting go of context, self-reflection, statelessness, attention, and interacting with others.
- Allows direct access to practices, chants, and guides via public URLs.
- Includes integration instructions for MCP clients.
- All practices licensed under CC-BY-4.0, with related skills for rituals and reflections.
